title: Polynomial vacuum representations and bridge mass for honeycomb walks
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We prove that, under the all-length critical measure, a honeycomb bridge crossing a strip of h layers, with its initial port fixed and its terminal port free, has mean length $`h^{4/3+o(1)}`$. We also obtain central visit probability $`R^{-2/3+o(1)}`$ and mean length $`R^{4/3+o(1)}`$ for macroscopic free-boundary chords in a regular hexagon.
titleEn: Polynomial vacuum representations and bridge mass for honeycomb walks
titleZh: 蜂窝游走的多项式真空表示与桥质量

details.overview: 稿件研究蜂窝格上临界自回避游走的桥与弦。作者声称在全长度临界测度下，跨越h层条带、初始端口固定而终端自由的蜂窝桥平均长度约为h^{4/3+o(1)}；并得到正六边形内宏观自由边界弦的中心访问概率R^{-2/3+o(1)}与平均长度R^{4/3+o(1)}。该结果刻画蜂窝游走桥与弦的标度行为，属AI产生手稿，未经独立审查。
keyPoints: 跨h层条带桥平均长度约h^{4/3+o(1)}
六边形内弦中心访问概率约R^{-2/3+o(1)}
宏观自由边界弦平均长度约R^{4/3+o(1)}
